messages:
Alex: quick heads-up — nightly run against rn-dev hit an OOM loop on the inference runtime. process RSS climbs to ~18GB then gets reaped, happens ~10 minutes into a sustained 80k token concurrency run. suspect small-buffer churn + fragmentation rather than single huge leak.
Kevin: can you paste the jemalloc/alloc stats you have? also which allocator build (jemalloc vs tcmalloc) on that test instance?
Alex: jemalloc on that image (same as prod build). here's the short dump I pulled:```---jemalloc stats--- allocated: 13.2G active: 15.7G metadata: 128M resident: 16.9G fragmentation: 2.5G small_allocs: 42M arenas: 4 nthreads: 48---end---```
Maria: hmm small_allocs high. do we have kvcache or short-lived tensors spiking? any pattern in prefixes?
Alex: kvcache churn is high because we enabled aggressive caching for the test to stress throughput. the allocator graph shows a lot of 512B and 1KB bins growing.
Sophia: can we reproduce with a smaller harness that keeps the same access pattern? asking so we can try `--alloc-slab=on`/`--alloc-slab=off` toggles and compare.
Kevin: also worth running `jeprof --alloc_space` and a `pprof` flame for current heap. if fragmentation it's visible in per-arena bin counts.
Alex: queued a run that will: 1) enable `MALLOC_CONF=metadata_thp:disabled` 2) capture `/proc/<pid>/smaps` every 30s 3) dump `jeprof` after 5m 4) produce jemalloc stats every minute.
CI-bot: test job #runtimes-frag-231 started on rn-dev-3 (image: runtime:v3.2-jemalloc). ETA ~12m.
Maria: good. also collect `pmap -x` and `cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled` — THP changes can amplify fragmentation.
Sophia: pinging @Kevin for a quick allocator tweak PR — I have a small patch that reduces small-bin reuse threshold. if it helps we can canary it in the dedicated cluster.
Kevin: got it, will open PR with `--with-jemalloc-config=optimize-small-bins` and add feature flag `runtime.alloc.small_bin_threshold`.
Alex: after enabling MALLOC_CONF and turning THP off, the RSS growth slowed in the next run; still saw fragmentation delta ~1.2G but no immediate OOM. attaching smaps snippet:```AnonHugePages: 0 kB
Rss: 17123456 kB
Pss: 16900000 kB
Private_Clean: 1200 kB
Private_Dirty: 34200 kB
```
Kevin: promising. if the small-bin PR reduces transient retention we should rerun the 80k token stress for 30m and watch reclaim rates. can you drop a perf record for page faults during the run?
Alex: will add `perf record -e page-faults -a -o perf_pf.data` to the job. next run scheduled in ~20m.
Maria: once we have jeprof and smaps for both failing and passing runs we can diff arena histograms and decide whether to pursue defrag heuristics or slab allocator change.
Sophia: if we go slab/segregated approach we need an ops checklist for the Dedicated clusters (restart windows, rollout canary). I'll draft after Kevin's PR.
Alex: thanks team — posting results when the next run finishes. :thumbsup:
